name: edu-payments
description: O'quv markazi to'lovlari: o'quvchilar, to'lovlar, oylik qarzdorlar

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
